gloss: residence card (for foreign residents in Japan)

definitions.explanation: An identification card issued to foreign nationals residing in Japan with a period of stay exceeding three months. It serves as the primary form of identification for non-Japanese residents.

examples.japanese: {在留|ざいりゅう}カード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧。
⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{在留|ざいりゅう}カード⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: I received my residence card at the airport.

examples.japanese: {在留|ざいりゅう}カード⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{有効|ゆうこう}{期限|きげん}→有効期限：06415_yuukoukigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。

notes:
An essential document for all foreign residents in Japan with a stay exceeding three months. The card displays the holder's name, nationality, residence status, period of stay, and address. Foreign residents are legally required to carry it at all times.

- {在留|ざいりゅう}カード⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: change of address on residence card

PRACTICAL INFORMATION:
The card is issued at the airport upon arrival or at the ⟦{出入国|しゅつにゅうこく}→出入国：24874_shutsunyuukoku⟧⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧{管理局|かんりきょく} (Immigration Services Agency). Address changes must be reported at the local ⟦{市区町村|しくちょうそん}→市区町村：23061_shikuchouson⟧⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧ (municipal office) within 14 days of moving.
